reasonToGo: The last drained ground before the crossing: grass for the stock, gravel underfoot, and a camp that is still standing when the water goes down.

hazards.name: Meltwater cold
hazards.description: Water off the shelf, milk-grey with rock flour. It takes the use out of a man's hands in the time it takes to wade one braid.

hazards.name: The thaw rise
hazards.description: The braids run hard in thaw and near-dry in deep cold. Ground that carried a cart last week carries nothing this week.
hazards.note: Absence hazard: a river coming up displaces people, it does not tick on them. No runtime zoneHazards type fits.

resources.name: Cropped grass
resources.description: Short turf between the braids, kept down by the stock that waits here for the crossing.

resources.name: The braided heads
resources.description: Gravel-bedded channels, fordable on foot in a dozen places, and the cleanest water on the road.

landmarks.name: The expedition camp
landmarks.description: Tents, picket lines and a stove that is never let out, set back from the highest braid.

landmarks.name: The gravel bars
landmarks.description: Pale banks of washed stone standing out of the water, with willow scrub taking hold along their spines.
